arxiv-2501-11893.creator: Jesse Morris *, Yiduo Wang, Mikolaj Kliniewski and Viorela Ila
arxiv-2501-11893.description: Abstract Traditional Visual Simultaneous Localization and Mapping systems focus solely on static scene structures, overlooking dynamic elements in the environment. Although effective for accurate visual odometry in complex scenarios, these methods discard crucial information about moving objects. By incorporating this information into a Dynamic SLAM framework, the motion of dynamic entities can be estimated, enhancing navigation whilst ensuring accurate localization.
